Year-Round Programs

Year-Round Programs FAQ

Verify a Certificate →
Does my child need prior experience to enroll?

No prior experience is needed for entry-level programs. Each department has beginner tracks designed to start from zero. If your child has some background, we assess them and place them in the right level.

How many hours per week and what is the schedule?

Most programs run 2 sessions per week, each 1.5 to 2 hours. You can choose morning or evening slots. The schedule is flexible and can be arranged at enrollment.

How long does each level take to complete?

Each level is approximately 12–16 hours of instruction, which takes around 6–8 weeks at 2 sessions per week. Students progress to the next level after passing a practical assessment.

Is there a certificate at the end?

Yes. Students who complete each level and pass the practical assessment receive an official Robotrick certificate for that level.

What does my child need to bring?

Nothing — all equipment, kits, and materials are provided at the center. Just bring a notebook if they like taking notes.

Can I try one session before committing?

Absolutely. We offer a free trial session for all new students. Contact us on WhatsApp to book a time.
